Field polygons from field objects

Source: R/delineate.R
fb_polygons.Rd

Converts field objects to polygons with their area, perimeter, compactness and, optionally, mean edge and cropland probability.

Usage

fb_polygons(fields, maps = NULL, simplify = 0, min_area = 0)

Arguments

fields

A SpatRaster of field objects from fb_delineate().

maps

Optional map SpatRaster whose layer means are added per field.

simplify

Simplification tolerance in map units (0 for none); in geographic coordinates a value around half a pixel removes the stair steps of pixel edges.

min_area

Minimum polygon area in square metres.

Value

An sf data frame with field_id, area_ha, perimeter_m, compactness (4 pi area / perimeter^2) and map means.

Examples

s <- fb_example_stack("california")
m <- fb_model_pretrained("california")
maps <- fb_tbc_maps(s, m)
p <- fb_polygons(fb_delineate(maps, thresholds = m$thresholds), maps)
head(p)
